home.hero.title: Vault42
home.hero.description: Production-grade JWT authentication. RS256 signed, fingerprint-bound, zero-trust by design.
home.feature.securityFirstDesc: Argon2id hashing, HIBP breach checks, constant-time comparisons, and encrypted-at-rest secrets.
home.feature.rs256Desc: Stateless access tokens with fingerprint binding, automatic key rotation, and strict algorithm enforcement.
home.feature.zeroDepsDesc: Minimal attack surface. TOTP, CORS, migrations, and JWKS — all hand-rolled from Go stdlib.

twoFactor.backup.description: Generate one-time recovery codes in case you lose access to your authenticator. Previous codes will be invalidated.
twoFactor.backup.saveWarning: Save these codes now. They will not be shown again.
twoFactor.backup.storeOffline: Store them offline in a secure location. Each code can only be used once.
